clue.text: Place for pictures taken from medicine man

clue.text: Take oneself off rota — clue must be revised

clue.text: Intermittently switch positions

clue.text: Source of economic news distorted in emails, in fact

clue.text: Admit learner inside a base

parts.note: base in the sense of low, ignoble

clue.text: Revolutionary measures creating distinctions that are academic

clue.text: Character that's referred to as 'Mother'

clue.text: Arrange aid and otherwise greatly help newspaper

clue.text: What singers and musicians do ain't bad on record

clue.text: Match, for example, that's not serious

clue.text: Retain it in memory, mostly, for musical performance

clue.text: Inferior to a couple of European articles

clue.text: Start off sick in this hospital that's rather crowded?

start off means the opening letter of sick is dropped

clue.text: One element or another turned over, with supporting information

clue.text: Maintaining distance apart, cut line with everyone aboard

clue.text: Salt put on sole and shellfish

clue.text: Succulents planted in midst of hectic activity
